interpretation.seasonCoachStats: One linked Wins/Losses record for the current season; no season/year key.
interpretation.careerCoachStats: One linked aggregate career resume record; no season-by-season rows or school-by-school sequence.
interpretation.inlineContractPoints: Three rolling scalar buckets: this year, last year, and two years ago.
interpretation.transactions: Dated staff-move ledger. In this Year 1 fixture, every coach transaction belongs to SeasonYear 0.
interpretation.awards: Current persisted CoachAward records; the fixture contains only two Season/PeriodIndex 0 awards.
interpretation.contractYearSummaries: Schema and empty tables exist, but no Coach references them at BW3 and both tables have zero active records.
